title: What's New in SearchDeadCode
summary: This release bundles searchdeadcode 0.19.1. The extension itself is unchanged; what changed is the analysis behind it.

highlights.title: Analyzer 0.19.1
highlights.description: The bundled analyzer moves to 0.19.1. Scans pick up its fixes with nothing to install: see the crate changelog for what changed in the analysis.

sections.title: Requirements
sections.body: The analyzer runs as a local process, so the extension needs a desktop VS Code. It is not available on vscode.dev.
